t: 法国对俄罗斯的入侵随着大军的残余被从俄罗斯驱逐而结束.
te: The French invasion of Russia comes to an end as the remnants of the Grande Armée are expelled from Russia.
dz: 法国对俄罗斯的入侵随着大军的残余被从俄罗斯驱逐而结束.
de: The French invasion of Russia comes to an end as the remnants of the Grande Armée are expelled from Russia.

t: 蒙哥菲尔兄弟在法国首次试飞无人热气球；它漂浮近 2.5 公里（1.6 英里）。
te: The Montgolfier brothers first test fly an unmanned hot air balloon in France; it floats nearly 2.5 km (1.6 mi).
dz: 蒙哥菲尔兄弟在法国首次试飞无人热气球；它漂浮近 2.5 公里（1.6 英里）。
de: The Montgolfier brothers first test fly an unmanned hot air balloon in France; it floats nearly 2.5 km (1.6 mi).

t: 创始人亚历山大·汉密尔顿(Alexander Hamilton)神父在纽约奥尔巴尼的斯凯勒人行…
te: Founding Father Alexander Hamilton marries Elizabeth Schuyler Hamilton at the Schuyler Mansion in Albany, New York.
dz: 创始人亚历山大·汉密尔顿(Alexander Hamilton)神父在纽约奥尔巴尼的斯凯勒人行宫与伊丽莎白·斯凯勒·汉密尔顿(Elizabeth Schuyler Hamilton)结婚.
de: Founding Father Alexander Hamilton marries Elizabeth Schuyler Hamilton at the Schuyler Mansion in Albany, New York.

t: 特蕾西亚军事学院成立于奥地利维纳诺伊施塔特.
te: The Theresian Military Academy is founded in Wiener Neustadt, Austria.
dz: 特蕾西亚军事学院成立于奥地利维纳诺伊施塔特.
de: The Theresian Military Academy is founded in Wiener Neustadt, Austria.

t: 玛丽·斯图亚特公主在父亲詹姆斯五世国王去世后一周就成为苏格兰女王.
te: Princess Mary Stuart becomes Queen of Scots at the age of one week on the death of her father, King James V.
dz: 玛丽·斯图亚特公主在父亲詹姆斯五世国王去世后一周就成为苏格兰女王.
de: Princess Mary Stuart becomes Queen of Scots at the age of one week on the death of her father, King James V.

t: 荷兰须德海海堤倒塌，造成 50,000 多人死亡。
te: The Zuiderzee sea wall in the Netherlands collapses, killing over 50,000 people.
dz: 圣卢西亚洪水：荷兰须德海海堤倒塌，造成 50,000 多人死亡。
de: St. Lucia's flood: The Zuiderzee sea wall in the Netherlands collapses, killing over 50,000 people.

t: 教宗约翰八世在哈德良二世去世后当选.
te: Pope John VIII is elected following the death of Hadrian II.
dz: 教宗约翰八世在哈德良二世去世后当选.
de: Pope John VIII is elected following the death of Hadrian II.

t: 唐朝皇帝文宗密谋杀害唐朝宫廷有势力的太监,但阴谋被挫败.
te: Emperor Wenzong of the Tang dynasty conspires to kill the powerful eunuchs of the Tang court, but the plot is foiled.
dz: 甜德事件:唐朝皇帝文宗密谋杀害唐朝宫廷有势力的太监,但阴谋被挫败.
de: Sweet Dew Incident: Emperor Wenzong of the Tang dynasty conspires to kill the powerful eunuchs of the Tang court, but the plot is foiled.

t: 君士坦丁堡被地震严重损毁,震中裂开了哈吉亚·索菲亚的穹顶.
te: Constantinople is severely damaged by an earthquake, which cracks the dome of Hagia Sophia.
dz: 君士坦丁堡被地震严重损毁,震中裂开了哈吉亚·索菲亚的穹顶.
de: Constantinople is severely damaged by an earthquake, which cracks the dome of Hagia Sophia.
